sections.heading: MINOR IN ENGLISH LANGUAGE AND LITERATURE (Brescia) - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - English and Writing Studies

Admission to this module is discontinued, effective September 1, 2025. Students currently enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the module requirements by August 31, 2028.
Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 course from English 1020-1999 with a mark of at least 60%. Students should consult with the Department prior to admission.
1.0 course: English 2301E or the former English 2307E.

1.5 courses from: English 2033E, English 2071F/G, English 2072F/G, English 2073F/G, English 2074F/G, English 2110E, English 2202F/G, English 2203F/G, English 2230F/G, English 2400E, English 2401E, English 2501E, English 2600F/G, English 2601E, English 3330E, English 3338E, English 3490F/G, English 3556E, English 3776F/G or the former English 2220F/G, the former English 2309E, the former English 2310E, the former English 2500E, the former English 3226E, the former English 3227E, the former English 3666F/G.

2.0 courses from: English 2337F/G, English 2357F/G, English 2696E, English 2877F/G, English 3318E, English 3319F/G, English 3326F/G, English 3328E, English 3329F/G, English 3347E, English 3348F/G, English 3349F/G, English 3365F/G, English 3366F/G, English 3368E, English 3377E, English 3378F/G, English 3379F/G, English 3479F/G, English 3579F/G or the former English 3115E, the former English 3116E, the former English 3224E, the former English 3228F/G, the former English 3334E, the former English 3336F/G, the former English 3444E, the former English 3446F/G, the former English 3554E, the former English 3557F/G.

Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
